**Research interests** — My research aims to elucidate how ovarian aging drives systemic aging in females, through multi-omics approaches and atlas construction to map the underlying molecular landscape.

## Education & Training

- 2026–present &nbsp; Postdoctoral Researcher, Aging Convergence Research Center, Korea Research Institute of Bioscience and Biotechnology (KRIBB)
- 2021–2026 &nbsp; Ph.D. Student, Department of Food and Biotechnology, Sejong University, Seoul, Korea
- 2015–2021 &nbsp; B.S. in Food Engineering, Hoseo University, Asan, Korea
